english.title: Import counterfeit notes / currency with intent to evade a prohibition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[imported]_
(B)_[was concerned in the importing of]_

the counterfeit of

(C)_[a currency note]_
(D)_[currency notes]_
(E)_[a protected coin]_
(F)_[protected coins]_

contrary to a prohibition in force by virtue of section 20 of the Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981 and with intent to evade the prohibition
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(3), (4) and (5A)(c) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
